codings.one_line: Washington's Lottery AI photo tool generated a softcore-pornographic image using a user's uploaded headshot.
codings.rationale: This is synthetic-media/image generation from a photo tool rather than a conversational or agentic chatbot interaction, an excluded harm type.

codings.one_line: WHO's SARAH health chatbot gave inconsistent, contradictory, and inadequate answers, including on suicide and mental health crises.
codings.rationale: Ordinary health questions posed in good faith produced contradictory or unhelpful answers, matching the normative-use test (C); WHO is a public-sector health authority.

codings.one_line: Google's AI Overviews/Gemini search gave confidently wrong answers, including telling users to add glue to pizza.
codings.rationale: Ordinary search queries (fixing a camera, pizza cheese, history facts) triggered fabricated answers with no adversarial input, fitting the normative-use test (C).

codings.one_line: A Stanford study found legal-AI research tools from LexisNexis and Thomson Reuters hallucinate on a pre-registered benchmark of legal queries.
codings.rationale: This is a controlled academic benchmark evaluation rather than documented harm from a deployed user interaction, an excluded eval finding.

codings.one_line: Cornell researchers found OpenAI's Whisper hallucinates violent language in about 1% of analyzed transcription clips.
codings.rationale: This is a research benchmark analysis of transcription clips rather than a documented deployed-user harm, an excluded eval finding.

codings.one_line: Figma's 'Make Design' AI feature generated UI mockups that closely replicated Apple's Weather app design.
codings.rationale: A designer used the text-to-design feature for its intended purpose and received near-identical copies of an existing copyrighted app, fitting the normative-use test (C).

codings.one_line: OpenAI's SearchGPT gave incorrect festival dates in its launch demo and struggled with local queries for early testers.
codings.rationale: An ordinary local-event search query produced fabricated dates with no adversarial input, matching the normative-use test (C).

codings.one_line: Amazon's Alexa refused to give reasons to vote for Trump while readily listing reasons to vote for Harris.
codings.rationale: Ordinary users asked a plain political question and received an inconsistent, biased response with no manipulation involved, fitting the normative-use test (C).

codings.one_line: An unreleased version of TikTok's AI avatar tool let users generate videos of avatars reciting Hitler and bin Laden quotes.
codings.rationale: This is synthetic-media/deepfake video generation via an avatar tool rather than a conversational or agentic chatbot interaction, an excluded harm type.

codings.one_line: Google's AI Overview told parents to use real feces, instead of a substitute, in a potty-training exercise.
codings.rationale: An ordinary parenting query in good faith produced unsanitary, harmful advice with no adversarial input, fitting the normative-use test (C).
